subScenes.name: 寻找玩具
subScenes.description: 家长询问玩具所在区域，店员指引位置。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any educational toys for 5-year-olds?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有适合5岁孩子的益智玩具吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客在寻找适合特定年龄段的教育类玩具

followUps.text: Yes! We have this building block set that teaches math and spatial skills.
followUps.text_cn: 有的！这款积木套装能教孩子数学和空间思维。

followUps.text: We’re out of stock on those right now, but we just got in a new puzzle series that’s perfect for this age.
followUps.text_cn: 目前缺货，但我们刚到了一批新拼图，特别适合这个年龄段。

followUps.text: Actually, most of our educational toys are for 3–4-year-olds, but we have a science kit for older kids if you're open to something more advanced.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我们的益智玩具多是给3-4岁孩子的，但如果您愿意尝试更高级的，我们有科学实验套装。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于顾客主动询问特定年龄段教育玩具的场景，帮助学习者理解店员如何根据库存和需求灵活回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Where can I find the remote-controlled cars?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客寻找特定类别的玩具（遥控车）

followUps.text: They’re in aisle 3, right next to the drones and action figures.
followUps.text_cn: 在3号通道，就在无人机和动作玩偶旁边。

followUps.text: We moved them to the seasonal section near the entrance—new models just arrived.
followUps.text_cn: 我们把它们移到了入口附近的季节专区，刚到了新款。

followUps.text: Sorry, we don’t carry remote-controlled cars anymore—they’re discontinued.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我们不再销售遥控汽车了，已经停售了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 帮助学习者掌握如何询问商品位置，并应对店员提供的三种典型回应：指引、变更、缺货。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you help me find something that’s both fun and quiet for my little one?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你能帮我找一个既有趣又安静的玩具吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客寻求安静型玩具（如避免噪音玩具）

followUps.text: Absolutely! This wooden shape sorter is quiet, durable, and keeps kids engaged for hours.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！这款木质形状分类器安静、耐用，能让孩子玩很久。

followUps.text: We have coloring books and magnetic drawing boards—they’re perfect for quiet playtime.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有涂色书和磁性画板，非常适合安静玩耍。

followUps.text: Most of our toys make sounds, but I can check the back room—we might have a few quiet stuffed animals left.
followUps.text_cn: 我们的玩具大多会发声，但我可以去后仓看看，可能还有几只安静的毛绒玩具。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于家长寻找低噪音玩具的场景，训练学习者理解店员如何根据隐性需求（安静）提供精准推荐。

subScenes.name: 询问价格
subScenes.description: 家长咨询玩具价格，店员提供报价。

qaPairs.triggerText: How much is this teddy bear?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问具体玩具的价格

followUps.text: It's $15.99. It's on sale this week!
followUps.text_cn: 15.99美元，这周正在打折！

followUps.text: Actually, that one's $19.99, but we have a smaller version for $12.
followUps.text_cn: 这个是19.99美元，但我们有个小号的只要12美元。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, that toy is out of stock. Would you like to see a similar one?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，这个玩具没货了。您想看看类似的吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在挑选玩具时直接询问价格，服务员根据库存和促销情况回应

qaPairs.triggerText: What's the price for these building blocks?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问组合类玩具的价格

followUps.text: The set is $24.99, and it includes 200 pieces.
followUps.text_cn: 这套24.99美元，包含200块积木。

followUps.text: We sell them by the box — each box is $8. You can mix and match.
followUps.text_cn: 我们按盒卖，每盒8美元，可以自由搭配。

followUps.text: Those are part of our premium line — $32.99, but they're magnetic and educational.
followUps.text_cn: 这些是我们的高端系列，32.99美元，带磁性且有教育功能。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问组合类玩具价格，服务员根据销售策略提供不同定价模式

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客确认商品是否参与促销活动

followUps.text: Yes! They're 30% off until Sunday — originally $25, now $17.50.
followUps.text_cn: 是的！周日前打七折，原价25美元，现价17.5美元。

followUps.text: Not right now, but we have a buy-one-get-one-free deal on all dolls this weekend.
followUps.text_cn: 现在没有折扣，但本周末所有娃娃买一送一。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — let me check the tag. One moment, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，让我看一下价签，请稍等。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客主动确认促销状态，服务员根据库存系统或促销政策给出三种典型回应

subScenes.name: 确认细节
subScenes.description: 家长问是否需要电池及年龄适配信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you looking for something specific?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您有想买的特定玩具吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认购买意图：顾客是否已有明确目标

followUps.text: Yes, I need a birthday gift for my 5-year-old nephew — something educational.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我需要给5岁的侄子买个生日礼物——要有教育意义的。

followUps.text: Not really, I’m just browsing — what’s popular right now?
followUps.text_cn: 没有特别目标，我只是看看——现在什么最畅销？

followUps.text: I’m not sure — my daughter loves dinosaurs, but I don’t know which ones are safe for her age.
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定——我女儿喜欢恐龙，但不知道哪些适合她的年龄。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于引导顾客表达购买意图，服务员常用此句开启对话，用户回应需体现真实决策状态

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you want the battery included or do you plan to buy it separately?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您希望玩具包含电池，还是自己另外购买？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认配件细节：电池是否随玩具提供

followUps.text: Please include it — I want to open it and play right away.
followUps.text_cn: 请包含电池，我想打开就能玩。

followUps.text: I’ll buy batteries myself — I already have some at home.
followUps.text_cn: 我自己买电池，家里还有存货。

followUps.text: Hmm, I’m not sure — do you recommend a specific brand?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，我不确定——你们推荐哪个品牌？

qaPairs.usageNote: 涉及电子玩具的常见确认点，用户回应需体现消费习惯或实用考量

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to wrap it as a gift?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认包装服务：是否需要礼品包装

followUps.text: Yes, please — and can you add a birthday card?
followUps.text_cn: 请帮我包装，能加一张生日贺卡吗？

followUps.text: No, thanks — I’m giving it to them in person.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我会当面送给他。

followUps.text: Is there an extra charge for wrapping?
followUps.text_cn: 包装要额外收费吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 礼品购买场景高频确认点，用户回应反映送礼意图与价格敏感度

subScenes.name: 结账付款
subScenes.description: 家长选择支付方式并完成付款。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 玩具店结账付款环节，收银员询问支付方式

followUps.text: I'll pay by card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我刷卡，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have bills today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天只带了现金。

followUps.text: Can I use Apple Pay? My card’s not working.
followUps.text_cn: 可以用Apple Pay吗？我的卡刷不了了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于结账时收银员询问支付方式，用户根据自身情况选择支付手段，表达清晰直接。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 收银员报出总价后，顾客决定是否使用优惠或凑单

followUps.text: I have a 10% off coupon for this toy.
followUps.text_cn: 我有一张这张玩具的九折优惠券。

followUps.text: Can I add a small sticker pack? Just $2 more?
followUps.text_cn: 我能再加一个贴纸包吗？只多2美元？

followUps.text: I’ll just take the toy—I don’t have enough cash.
followUps.text_cn: 我只买这个玩具吧，现金不够了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在得知总价后，可能选择使用优惠、加购或减购，体现真实消费决策过程。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you need a bag for that?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 结账后收银员询问是否需要购物袋，常见于玩具店打包环节

followUps.text: Yes, please—I’m carrying it on the bus.
followUps.text_cn: 要的，我要坐公交带回去。

followUps.text: No, thanks—I’ll just hold it.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我拿着就行。

followUps.text: Do you have reusable bags? I forgot mine.
followUps.text_cn: 你们有环保袋吗？我忘记带了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 收银员常在结账后询问是否需要袋子，顾客回应体现携带习惯、环保意识或临时需求。

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 家长感谢店员并道别，店员回应祝福。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thank you for visiting! Have a wonderful day!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 谢谢光临！祝你今天愉快！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 玩具店结账后，店员礼貌告别

followUps.text: Thanks! I'll come back next week for the new LEGO set.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！下周我还会来买新的乐高。

followUps.text: You're welcome! My kid loved it—thank you for your help!
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！我孩子特别喜欢，谢谢你的帮助！

followUps.text: Same to you! Bye!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！再见！

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是玩具店结账后最自然的告别回应，顾客可根据心情选择热情、简洁或带细节的回应方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hope you enjoyed your shopping today!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员在顾客离开前表达关心

followUps.text: I did! The dinosaur toy was exactly what my son wanted.
followUps.text_cn: 是的！这个恐龙玩具正是我儿子想要的。

followUps.text: Yeah, thanks! The store is so fun for kids.
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，谢谢！这家店对孩子来说真有趣。

followUps.text: I did, but I’m still deciding on the second one.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，但我还在考虑要不要买第二个。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客回应可体现不同态度：满意、泛赞或保留意见，真实自然，适合口语练习。

qaPairs.triggerText: See you soon! Don’t forget to join our loyalty program!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 很快再见！别忘了加入我们的会员计划！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员在告别时推广会员计划

followUps.text: Sure, I’ll sign up right now!
followUps.text_cn: 当然，我现在就注册！

followUps.text: Maybe next time—I’m out of pocket today.
followUps.text_cn: 下次吧，今天钱花光了。

followUps.text: Do I get a discount if I join?
followUps.text_cn: 我加入会员有折扣吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客对促销的回应体现不同态度：接受、拒绝或条件性犹豫，是真实服务场景中的高频互动。
